name: Emaki Scroll
description: A picture scroll on two wooden rollers that winds from one roller to the other as the page scrolls.

props.name: children
props.description: The panels of the scroll, usually EmakiPanel elements, in reading order. Each takes an equal share of the paper.

props.name: direction
props.description: Reading direction. With rtl the first panel starts at the right and the paper travels right as the page scrolls down; ltr mirrors the scroll, its shading and its panels.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the paper in pixels. It is reduced on narrow screens and on short windows so the whole scroll fits.

props.name: length
props.description: Page scroll distance per panel, in viewport heights. The section is one screen taller than the panels need, and its inner stage sticks to the top of the window.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer section. Other section props, such as aria-labelledby, are passed through.

props.name: title
props.description: The panel's heading, set vertically in a narrow column at the side where the panel begins. It is also named in the progress note under the scroll.

props.name: src
props.description: The picture, mounted on the paper with a margin around it.

props.name: children
props.description: A line or two of text under the picture.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the panel's article element. Other article props are passed through.
